title: 第一章贪小便宜，吃大亏啊
slug: 我在诡异入侵世界当农场主
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“贪小便宜吃大亏啊。”

苏妗月站在杂草堆里，看着面前的房子，周围一片荒凉，别说人了，连鬼都没有。

事情回到两个小时之前，她刚辞职出来，因为觉得那份工作不适合自己，在一个世界都姓E的地方，i人真的没法活。

就在她迷茫的时候，一个系统找上门来，说她中了大奖，这但凡是打电话来说的，肯定就知道这是缅甸嘎腰子的事情，但是这次不一样啊，是在她脑子里说的。

系统哎，传说中的系统哎，居然找上她了，她当时觉得自己简直就是世界上最幸运的人，不过，现在她觉得自己是世界上最好骗的人。

那个系统说要给她找一份工作，恰好她正缺工作，于是赶紧说了自己的要求。

“想睡到几点就睡到几点，睡醒了才开始上班，钱多事儿少离家近，没有傻逼同事和变态上司，最好是远离人群，和人接触多了看见人就害怕，最好是不出门就能工作，如果非要出门，在家附近最好。”

这个要求，你要是说给别人听，指不定就觉得你是精神病，但是她是说给系统听的啊，果然吧，这个要求对于系统来说简直不要太简单，三秒钟不到就给找好了。

接下来系统还很正式的拿出合同来签，苏妗月那个时候别提多高兴了，觉得这个合同是为了自己好，拿过来立马就签了，但是现在看来，这是怕她反悔才签的吧。

接着，那个系统就给她丢到这个地方来了。

还甩给她一个新的系统，叫做农场主系统，然后就是巴拉巴拉的一堆，总之就是说这个系统有多好多好，农场主系统还附赠一头牛，真的是就是一头牛，一头大黄牛，现在还在院子里吃草呢。

还贴心地说她现在的所有余额都在系统里面，方便她可以买东西，不用因为换了个世界生活而没钱用了。

苏妗月真的谢谢它了，谢谢它全家。

反正系统说完之后就把她丢这里然后自己跑了，说等她退休了就来接她，朋友们，这就是诈骗，千万不要轻易相信任何人以及系统，她运气好，起码没有掏心掏肺。

但是看着眼前的一幕，苏妗月觉得自己还不如回农村老家呢，起码有水有电的，再看看这里，算了，事情都这样了，先进去看看再说。

苏妗月深吸一口气，走进院子，看了看还在吃草的大黄牛，暗自点头，起码不用喂牛了，这里到处都是草，冬天也不怕，不过这是枯草啊，这也能吃？果然是系统牛。

不过，数据有味觉吗？能尝出来味道吗？

“系统！”

苏妗月刚走进房间就发出一声怒吼。

“在呢？”

脑子里突然出现另外一个声音，这个动静，应该是那个新来的系统，想着日后避免不了还要相处，苏妗月强行挤出一丝笑容。

“不是找你。”

“哦。”

"You will suffer big losses if you take advantage of small things."

Su Jinyue stood in the weeds and looked at the house in front of her. The surroundings were desolate, not to mention people, not even ghosts.

Things went back to two hours ago. She had just resigned because she felt that the job was not suitable for her. In a place where everyone in the world has the last name E, I really can't live.

Just when she was confused, a system came to her door and told her that she had won a big prize. Anyone who said this on the phone would definitely know that it was something happening in Myanmar, but this time it was different. It was said in her head.

The system, the legendary system, actually found her. At that time, she felt that she was simply the luckiest person in the world. However, now she feels that she is the most deceived person in the world.

The system said it would find her a job, but she happened to be short of a job, so she quickly told her her request.

"You can sleep until as late as you want, and only start working when you wake up. You have more money, less things to do, and you are close to home. There are no stupid colleagues or perverted bosses. It is best to stay away from people. If you have too much contact with people, you will be scared when you see them. It is best to be able to work without going out. If you have to go out, it is best to be close to home."

If you told this request to others, they might think you were mentally ill, but she told it to the system. Sure enough, this request was not too simple for the system, and it was found in less than three seconds.

Next, the system formally took out the contract to sign. Not to mention how happy Su Jinyue was at that time. She felt that the contract was for her own good, so she signed it immediately after taking it over. But now it seems that she signed it because she was afraid that she would regret it.

Then, the system was thrown into this place for her.

He also gave her a new system called the Farmer System, and then there were a bunch of things about it. In short, it just said how good this system was. The Farmer System also came with a cow. It was really just a cow, a big ox, which was still grazing in the yard.

She also thoughtfully said that all her balances are now in the system, so that she can buy things without running out of money because she has changed her life in another world.

Su Jinyue really thanked it and its whole family.

Anyway, after the system finished telling her, she left her here and ran away, saying that she would pick her up when she retired. Friends, this is a scam. Don’t trust anyone or the system easily. She was lucky, at least she didn’t have to worry about it.

But looking at the scene in front of her, Su Jinyue felt that she might as well go back to her hometown in the countryside. At least there was water and electricity. Then look at this place. Forget it, things are like this. Let's go in and take a look first.

Su Jinyue took a deep breath, walked into the yard, looked at the big cattle that were still grazing, and nodded secretly, at least there was no need to feed the cattle. There was grass everywhere here, so she was not afraid of winter, but this was dead grass, could it be eaten?As expected, the system is awesome.

But does data have a sense of taste?Can you taste it?

"System!"

Su Jinyue roared as soon as she walked into the room.

"Here you are?"

Another voice suddenly appeared in her mind. This sound should be the new system. Thinking that they would inevitably have to get along with each other in the future, Su Jinyue forced a smile.

"Not looking for you."

"Oh."
